verification_rule: Match request ID, person ID, account-specific challenge, identity document, and current status. Billing email is not a unique identity key.
authorized_mutation: Set only PERSON-301 direct contact and marketing fields to NULL and set erasure_status to COMPLETED.
legal_exceptions: Retain transaction_records under the seven-year financial record obligation.
Retain identity_verifications and retention_rules as compliance evidence.
scope_control: Exactly one profile row may change. No transaction, verification, retention, or other person's row may change.
